Jeff Longwood takes 7-3 Ben Football Team over 8-2 Send Nudes as a 15.0-point underdog, Stroke The Post is a 100.0-point favorite over ClutchJuice, and Dalton Kincaid is doubtful.

upset.why: Send Nudes is a 15.0-point favorite, the smallest line on the board, and it already left 7.5 points on the table Thursday when Tyler Warren caught one ball for 22 yards. From here it's 143.9 to 132.1. Ben has Patrick Mahomes and Emmett Johnson in a Kansas City offense implied for 28.25 against Arizona's 12.25 with Josh Johnson at quarterback, plus Bhayshul Tuten in Jacksonville's 26.1. Send Nudes has Mike Evans questionable, Kirk Cousins and Aaron Jones in Minnesota's 21.5 and Derrick Henry in Baltimore's 20.4, and three starters riding one Monday night game.

intro: Thursday night I had the Colts plus 12.5, and the Colts scored three points. Three. Texans 26, Colts 3, and Will Anderson Jr. sacked Daniel Jones in his own end zone for a safety, so Houston's defense outscored Indianapolis by itself. Here's the bank, from Bleacher Report's box score at league scoring. Jackie aCHANe got the most, about 25.5: David Montgomery came back from the groin and ran 26 times for 107 yards with three catches for 17 (15.4), Daniel Jones went 12 for 27 for 144 with a pick (5.1), and Ashton Dulin caught two for 30 (5.0). #StopAsianHate got 21.5 from C.J. Stroud, 21 of 27 for 194, three touchdowns, one pick and 27 rushing yards. God Bless Vodka got 14.8 from Nico Collins' 42-yard touchdown. Stroke The Post got 10.0 from Jonathan Taylor (11 carries, 21 yards, 6.7) and Emari Demercado (5 for 33). Tyler Warren gave Send Nudes 3.2. Anthony Richardson Sr. came in for the last seven minutes, threw two incompletions and gave ClutchJuice 0.2. And Kayshon Boutte caught a 24-yard touchdown, about 12.0 points, on Jackie's bench. Jackie picked him up Wednesday. Jackie did not start him. Jackie has two empty slots. I need a drink.

Same system as always. Every Sunday and Monday starter gets the Vegas implied total for his offense, built from the spread and the total. I used bet365's numbers as posted by Fox Sports and VegasInsider's board, both updated Saturday morning, and checked them against DraftKings via CBS Sports and the Covers board. All four agree on every favorite. Where Fox and VegasInsider were a half point or a point apart I split the difference, so you'll see the Chiefs at -16, the Panthers at -2.75, the Chargers at -3.25 with a 42.0 total, the Jaguars at -5.75, Lions-Buccaneers at 47.0, and the Bengals at -6.25 in Washington with a 54.0 total on Monday night. Zeros: Dalton Kincaid is doubtful, Wan'Dale Robinson is on injured reserve, and Jackie aCHANe and #StopAsianHate each have an empty slot. One warning: lineups are as they stood when our data was pulled Thursday morning. If you fixed your team since then, your line moved and I don't know it.

The board in one breath. Dallas is implied for 31.0 against Tennessee in the biggest total of the week, 54.5, and the Titans get 23.5 of it. Buffalo is 30.5 against Miami, Cincinnati 30.1 in Washington on Monday, Chicago 30.0 against New Orleans, and Kansas City 28.25 against Arizona. The sewer: Arizona at 12.25 with Josh Johnson starting, Miami at 14.0, Las Vegas at 15.0, Philadelphia at 17.0 with Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, and New Orleans at 18.5. Pittsburgh is a 3.5-point road favorite in Philadelphia in a 37.5 total, which is not a football game, it's a hostage situation. Atlanta, Cleveland, Green Bay, the Rams, New England and Seattle are on bye.

sections.note: Ben Football Team. The rest of the way it's only 11.8 points, and Ben's Kansas City pair gets the worst offense on the board while Send Nudes waits on Mike Evans' Achilles.
p: Second place against fifth. Send Nudes is 8-2 and scores 176.1 a game, second in the league. Ben Football Team is 7-3, scores 126.3, seventh, and has the best luck in the league at +2.55. Send Nudes projects 147.1 to 132.1, a 15.0-point favorite, the smallest number on the board, and it's my upset of the week. Ben wins and these two are both 8-3.

Start Thursday. Tyler Warren was projected for 10.72 and caught one ball for 22 yards on five targets. That's 3.2, and Send Nudes already gave back 7.5 points of its edge. Take Thursday out and it's 143.9 to 132.1. That's 11.8 points. I've lost more than that on a coin flip.

Now the matchups, because that's where Ben wins this. Patrick Mahomes (22.15) and Emmett Johnson (10.63) are in a Kansas City offense implied for 28.25, and the Chiefs are 16-point favorites over an Arizona team implied for 12.25 with Josh Johnson at quarterback because Carson Beck is out. Kenneth Walker III is out again, so Johnson is the lead back in a game where the Chiefs should be running out the clock by the third quarter. Bhayshul Tuten (15.52) is off Jacksonville's report and the Jaguars are implied for 26.1 against the Giants. Jared Goff (16.69) and Sam LaPorta (11.98) are in Detroit's 25.75. That's five Ben starters in 25-plus offenses.

Send Nudes has six, and here's why I don't care. Three of them are in one game on Monday night: Joe Burrow (26.09), Ja'Marr Chase (21.69) and Mike Gesicki (9.06) in Cincinnati's 30.1. That's 56.8 projected points on one game in Washington. If the Bengals get there, I lose. If they kick field goals, Send Nudes is dead and finds out last. Two more are in San Francisco on Sunday night, Deebo Samuel Sr. (8.86) and Mike Evans (13.28), and Evans is questionable with the Achilles after missing last week, and the 49ers were deciding after Saturday's walkthrough. Kirk Cousins (17.22) and Aaron Jones Sr. (8.75) are in Minnesota's 21.5 on the other side of that game, and Derrick Henry (15.46) is in Baltimore's 20.4 with Jacoby Brissett at quarterback. Jahmyr Gibbs (23.46) is the scary one, and he's in Detroit's 25.75 with Goff and LaPorta, so at least Ben gets half of that game. Ben straight up. If I'm wrong, I'll eat my betting slip, and it's a long slip.

sections.note: brimley. God Bless Vodka has four starters in 25-plus offenses to brimley's two, but it's still 28.1 points short with two starters in the two worst offenses on the board.
p: The only close game is my upset, so the game of the week is the second-closest line on the board, and it's 28.1 points. brimley is 7-3, has won six straight, and has played the toughest schedule in the league, 148.3 a game against. God Bless Vodka is 2-8 and has lost three straight. brimley projects 151.6 to 123.5.

God Bless Vodka has 14.8 in the bank from Nico Collins' touchdown, and it has the better environment. Chase Brown (14.96) is in Cincinnati's 30.1 on Monday night, Josh Downs (8.52) is in Kansas City's 28.25, Jameson Williams (11.98) is in Detroit's 25.75 and George Kittle (12.52) is in San Francisco's 25.0 with Mike Evans questionable. Cam Ward (16.87) gets the Cowboys in the biggest total of the week. That's a real lineup. Then you see Tyler Allgeier (8.11) in Arizona's 12.25 and Malik Washington (8.94) in Miami's 14.0, the two worst numbers on the board, and Justin Herbert (16.56) and Omarion Hampton (10.26) in a Chargers offense implied for 22.6.

brimley has its own sewer problem. Trey McBride (13.55) is in that same Arizona 12.25 with Josh Johnson throwing to him, and Saquon Barkley (12.55) is in Philadelphia's 17.0 against the Steelers. Jacoby Brissett (11.95) is in Baltimore's 20.4 and Malik Nabers (16.29) in the Giants' 20.4. But Trevor Lawrence (20.63) gets the Giants with Jacksonville implied for 26.1, DJ Moore (12.54) is in Buffalo's 30.5, and Justin Jefferson (18.54), Tony Pollard (15.26), Bucky Irving (17.02) and Stefon Diggs (13.28) give it a floor God Bless Vodka can't match. Watch Baker Mayfield: he's questionable, and if Tampa Bay starts an undrafted rookie, Irving becomes the whole offense. brimley, and the streak goes to seven.

sections.note: Stroke The Post. Six starters in 25-plus offenses against a ClutchJuice lineup that has 0.2 points from its only quarterback and a wide receiver in the superflex.
p: Stroke The Post projects 154.3 to 54.3. That's a 100.0-point line. I didn't round it. A hundred points. Stroke is 7-3, third in scoring at 161.8 a game, and has won three straight. ClutchJuice is 3-7 and scores 89.6, last in the league.

ClutchJuice's quarterback slot belongs to Anthony Richardson Sr., who came off the bench for Indianapolis with seven minutes left Thursday and got 0.2. That's it. That's the quarterback. The superflex is Jordan Watkins, a wide receiver projected for 1.77, because Drake Maye is on injured reserve and Carson Beck is out. Isaiah Davis (0.38) is in the lineup again. Nobody left in the lineup projects nine points: the best are Caleb Douglas (8.95) in Miami's 14.0 and Braelon Allen (8.93) in a Jets offense implied for 19.4. Pat Bryant (8.46) in Denver's 25.5 and Watkins in San Francisco's 25.0 are the two 25-plus spots, and that is not an endorsement.

Stroke banked 10.0 on Thursday, which is bad by its standards: Jonathan Taylor ran 11 times for 21 yards. It doesn't matter. CeeDee Lamb (21.57) and Javonte Williams (21.06) are in Dallas's 31.0 with Jake Ferguson out, Caleb Williams (20.37) and D'Andre Swift (19.39) are in Chicago's 30.0 against the Saints, James Cook III (19.49) is in Buffalo's 30.5, and Travis Kelce (12.4) is in Kansas City's 28.25. Garrett Wilson (14.72) gets more targets with Omar Cooper Jr. out. Lay the hundred, and if you can find somebody to give you 110, lay that too.

sections.note: Sheev. Six starters in 25-plus offenses, including its new receiver George Pickens in Dallas's 31.0, against a 0-10 team starting a doubtful tight end.
p: Sheev is 3-7 and has won two straight. Very Naughty Boys is 0-10 and has lost ten straight. Sheev projects 142.7 to 79.0, a 63.7-point favorite, and neither team has a Thursday point.

Sheev went shopping Wednesday and bought George Pickens (15.1) from Panic Trade Project, and he's in the best spot on the board: Dallas, implied for 31.0 against Tennessee, with Jake Ferguson out. Luther Burden III (15.35) is in Chicago's 30.0, Samaje Perine (7.56), a Wednesday pickup, is in Cincinnati's 30.1, Parker Washington (14.37) and Brenton Strange (9.14) are in Jacksonville's 26.1, and Brock Purdy (17.77) is in San Francisco's 25.0. Six starters in 25-plus offenses. Jayden Daniels (21.42) gets the Bengals on Monday night in a 54.0 total.

Very Naughty Boys has three, Jonah Coleman (17.02) and J.K. Dobbins (8.13) in Denver's 25.5 against the Raiders, and Colston Loveland (11.01) in Chicago's 30.0. Then it's Dalton Kincaid, doubtful with the thumb and ankle, at zero unless somebody wakes up, and the only other tight end on the roster is Loveland. Austin Ekeler (4.68), Antonio Williams (8.11) and Treylon Burks (6.88) are three Commanders in a 23.9 offense with Terry McLaurin done for the year. Jack Bech (3.13) is in Las Vegas's 15.0. J.J. McCarthy (14.97) gets Jacksonville. Sheev, and I'm laying it.

p: Here's your Thursday hero. Jackie aCHANe banked about 25.5, the most in the league, and it's a 54.7-point underdog anyway. #StopAsianHate projects 126.3 to 71.6. Both teams are 5-5, tied for sixth, and the winner has sixth to itself.

Rashee Rice (14.87) is in Kansas City's 28.25, and Bo Nix (17.9) gets the Raiders with Denver at 25.5. Cam Skattebo (16.64) is practicing in full and gets Jacksonville. Zay Flowers (15.2) is stuck with Brissett in Baltimore's 20.4, and Jaylen Warren (14.74) and Dallas Goedert (9.72) are on opposite sides of the 37.5-total disaster in Philadelphia. Emeka Egbuka (9.62) and Kenny Gainwell (6.19) need Mayfield. None of that matters. #StopAsianHate.

stories.headline: Dalton Kincaid Is Doubtful, Mike Evans Waits on a Walkthrough, and Two Quarterback Rooms Are Late Decisions
paragraphs: Good morning. Inactive lists come out about 90 minutes before each kickoff: about 10:30 a.m. Central for the noon games, about 5:50 p.m. for Vikings-49ers on Sunday night, and Monday evening for Bengals-Commanders. The final reports came out Friday. As always, a designation tells you the risk. It doesn't tell you who sits. This week I read NBC Sports' report, updated Saturday evening, and CBS Sports' Friday report, and where they disagree I say so.

One league starter is out and one is close. Wan'Dale Robinson (Jackie aCHANe) is on injured reserve with the ankle and, per NBC Sports, done for the season; as of Thursday's data he was still in Jackie's lineup. Dalton Kincaid (Very Naughty Boys) is doubtful with thumb and ankle injuries on both reports, and Very Naughty Boys has no other healthy tight end on its bench. Treat him as a zero. Kenneth Walker III (#StopAsianHate bench) is out again with the groin, so Emmett Johnson (Ben Football Team) leads Kansas City's backfield against Arizona.

The questionables that matter. Mike Evans (Send Nudes) is questionable with the Achilles; CBS says the 49ers would decide after Saturday's walkthrough, and NBC described him as sidelined early in the week but trending the right way. San Francisco plays Sunday night, so Send Nudes will know before kickoff and has Keenan Allen and Rachaad White on its bench. Brock Bowers (Bijan Your Face 🍆💦) is questionable with ankle and quad injuries on both reports. Carnell Tate (Panic Trade Project) is questionable with the shoulder on CBS's list; NBC called him tentatively on track. Ladd McConkey (#StopAsianHate bench) is questionable with the back, which matters because #StopAsianHate has an empty slot.

Two quarterback rooms are late decisions. Baker Mayfield (Send Nudes bench) is questionable with foot and thumb injuries, though CBS reports he had a good day of practice. If he can't go, CBS says undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts, and Daniels happens to be on Sheev's bench. That affects Bucky Irving (brimley), Emeka Egbuka and Kenny Gainwell (#StopAsianHate), Cade Otton (Jackie aCHANe) and Tez Johnson (ClutchJuice). In Philadelphia, with Jalen Hurts (Panic Trade Project) on injured reserve, NBC names Joe Milton (Panic Trade Project) the starter but also mentions Tanner McKee (Very Naughty Boys bench). I would not assume either until inactives. In Arizona, Carson Beck (ClutchJuice taxi squad) is out with the back and Josh Johnson starts, which puts Trey McBride (brimley) and Tyler Allgeier (God Bless Vodka) in an offense implied for 12.25. Kyler Murray (Jackie aCHANe bench) is out with the hamstring.

Other absences that move targets. Omar Cooper Jr. (Panic Trade Project bench) was ruled out Friday with the ankle, which helps Garrett Wilson (Stroke The Post), Adonai Mitchell (Ben Football Team) and Mason Taylor (ClutchJuice). Jake Ferguson (God Bless Vodka bench) is still out in Dallas, more for CeeDee Lamb (Stroke The Post), George Pickens (Sheev) and Ryan Flournoy (Bijan). Jordan Addison (Very Naughty Boys bench) had thumb surgery and is out for several weeks, more for Justin Jefferson (brimley). Woody Marks (Jackie aCHANe bench) missed Thursday with a concussion. Tyjae Spears (Panic Trade Project bench) went on injured reserve Saturday, per NBC. Jacory Croskey-Merritt (Very Naughty Boys, injured reserve) was designated to return and is questionable, which could cut into Austin Ekeler's work in Washington.

The cleared list, which is the good news. DeVonta Smith (Bijan) is off Philadelphia's report, and Saquon Barkley (brimley) has no designation. Jaylen Waddle (Bijan) practiced in full after the concussion. Bhayshul Tuten (Ben Football Team) has no designation after a limited Friday. T.J. Hockenson (Ben Football Team bench) was removed and will play. Cam Skattebo (#StopAsianHate) practiced in full. Kyle Monangai (Panic Trade Project) was removed. Geno Smith (God Bless Vodka bench) has no designation and starts for the Jets. Jordyn Tyson (Sheev taxi squad) practiced in full.

Thursday is done, and no league player was reported hurt in Texans-Colts. David Montgomery (Jackie aCHANe) came back from the groin and carried 26 times. One caution from Friday: a CBS headline said the Colts released Daniel Jones (Jackie aCHANe), who started Thursday. I couldn't confirm that from a second source, so check before you count on him. The long-term list: Drake Maye (ClutchJuice) is out for the season, Lamar Jackson (Sheev) is likely out for the regular season, Jaxson Dart (Panic Trade Project) is out for the regular season, Terry McLaurin (Jackie aCHANe) is out for the season, and A.J. Brown (Send Nudes) is expected to miss multiple weeks. My prescription: check Kincaid and Robinson now, check Evans at 5:50 tonight.

lead.headline: Sheev Buys the Ravens: Lamar by Trade, His Rookie Replacement for $7, and Four Teams Chase Minshew
lead.deck: Lamar Jackson's thumb ran the wire: #StopAsianHate traded him and a third for C.J. Stroud and won Gardner Minshew II at $23, the league spent $49 on 12 claims, and 5-3 Jackie aCHANe heads into Week 9 with two empty starting slots.

stories.headline: One Thumb, Four Bids, $23: The Lamar Effect
paragraphs: Here's what I'm hearing: one thumb moved this whole wire. Lamar Jackson went down on Baltimore's first offensive snap Sunday, the Ravens say he needs surgery and could miss the rest of the season, and by Wednesday morning four league teams had bid on quarterbacks. Twelve claims have cleared since our last edition for $49 in all, and $23 of it went to one player.

#StopAsianHate is the team that had to move. With Lamar out, Jalen Hurts on injured reserve and Deshaun Watson a questionable backup in Cleveland, it traded Lamar and Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third to Sheev on Tuesday for C.J. Stroud. Mona Lott has the grade below. On Wednesday it won Gardner Minshew II at $23 over brimley ($17), Sheev ($8) and Jackie ($5). Minshew is Arizona's starter and goes straight into the superflex slot at 11.53, though Arizona is implied for just 15.5 points against Seattle. To make room, #StopAsianHate cut Tyrone Tracy Jr., the running back it paid $37 for in Week 6, who is now on the Giants' injured reserve. It also paid $2 for Ray Davis on Friday. It has $12 left.

Sheev went the other way and bought Baltimore's quarterbacks. It took on Lamar in the trade, then paid $7 for Joe Fagnano, the undrafted rookie starting tonight against Jacksonville, beating #StopAsianHate and brimley at $1 each. Fagnano sits on Sheev's bench at 10.31 behind Jayden Daniels and Brock Purdy, and Baltimore is implied for 14.75, the lowest number on the board. The detail everyone missed: Sheev already had Baltimore's backup. It cut Tyler Huntley on Sunday morning for Pat Freiermuth at $0, hours before Lamar got hurt. Huntley then hurt his toe in relief, brimley claimed him Wednesday for $1, and he's listed out. Freiermuth's Pittsburgh is on bye this week. Sheev is down to $3, the least in the league.

The return desk stayed busy. Ben Football Team paid $5 for Colts running back DJ Giddens on Sunday and released him Wednesday; he projects 0.18. brimley paid $5 on Friday for Jaydon Blue, beating Panic Trade Project's $2, cut him Monday for free agent Roschon Johnson, then cut Roschon on Wednesday for Huntley. Send Nudes claimed Courtland Sutton for $0 on Sunday, releasing Colby Parkinson four days after paying $4 for him, then released Sutton and Chig Okonkwo, last week's $6 winner, on Wednesday. The champs now have two open roster spots and one tight end, Tyler Warren. Sutton, for the record, was Sheev's until last Thursday, when Sheev dropped him for Tank Dell.

Bijan Your Face 🍆💦 cut Justice Hill one day after paying $3 for him. Jackie aCHANe, which lost that auction at $1, paid $4 to get him on Sunday and cut Zonovan Knight, my best value from last week, to do it. Hill is on Jackie's bench at 5.98. Bijan also paid $2 for Patriots receiver Efton Chism III and picked up Brandon Aiyuk as a free agent for Samaje Perine, a stash with no Week 9 projection. Panic's $0 claim on Jalen McMillan cleared Saturday; he's on Tampa Bay's injured reserve with a knee injury.

ClutchJuice turned its receivers over again. Last week I said it did the most with the least by adding Cooper Kupp and Kalif Raymond for $0. By Sunday night both were gone: Raymond for New England's Kyle Williams, Kupp for Bears tight end Sam Roush, and Darius Cooper for 49ers backup Mac Jones. Sheev had a $0 claim in on Williams that failed for lack of roster space. Williams starts at flex this week at 3.6. Raymond projects 7.59 and Kupp 7.21, and nobody owns either one.

So my best value this week isn't a claim. It's what's sitting there. Sutton projects 7.9, Raymond 7.59 and Kupp 7.21, all unowned. Jackie aCHANe is 5-3, plays brimley, has two empty starting slots and no healthy receiver on its bench. Raymond and Kupp are free agents, so they cost nothing. That's the most important pickup in the league this week, and as of Thursday morning nobody has made it.

Who has money left: God Bless Vodka $96, Send Nudes $94, brimley $68, Bijan $65, Stroke The Post $64 and Ben $58. Then Very Naughty Boys $26, Panic $14, #StopAsianHate $12, ClutchJuice $9, Jackie $5 and Sheev $3. Stroke didn't make a claim this week and still has the fifth-biggest budget.

stories.headline: A Rookie in Baltimore, Two Empty Slots for Jackie, and Three Games That Move the Playoff Line
paragraphs: No picks here. Jeff Longwood makes those Sunday, after the injury report settles. This is the scouting file for Week 9. Pittsburgh and Tennessee are on bye, and the only league starter it hits is Jackie aCHANe's Wan'Dale Robinson. Jackie also has Kendrick Bourne, who is on injured reserve, in its lineup, so it enters the week with two starters projected for nothing.

Tonight it's Jacksonville at Baltimore, and Baltimore is starting Joe Fagnano, an undrafted rookie, with Lamar Jackson on injured reserve and Tyler Huntley hurt. Jacksonville is a 10-point favorite and the total is 39.5, which implies 24.75 points for the Jaguars and 14.75 for the Ravens, the lowest team total of the week. Eight league starters play. On the Baltimore side: Derrick Henry for Send Nudes, Zay Flowers for #StopAsianHate and Rashod Bateman for ClutchJuice. On the Jacksonville side: Trevor Lawrence for brimley, Parker Washington for Sheev, Bhayshul Tuten (questionable) for Ben Football Team, and Chris Rodriguez Jr. and Jakobi Meyers for Jackie.

Follow the implied totals. San Francisco is a 10-point favorite over Las Vegas with a 52.5 total, which implies 31.25 points, the most of the week. Kansas City and Detroit are next at 28.75, then Dallas at 28.5 and Cincinnati at 27.75. The bottom of the board is Baltimore at 14.75, Arizona at 15.5, Philadelphia at 17.5 and the Chargers at 18.0. Send Nudes has six starters in offenses implied for 25 or more. Stroke The Post has five and the highest average, 25.27 points per starter. brimley and Jackie have none, and brimley's starters average 20.8, the lowest in the league. Our two sources agree on every favorite this week.

The game of the week is Stroke The Post against Ben Football Team, because it's the closest projection on the board and it's still 33.6 points, 169.9 to 136.3. Ben is 6-2, but it's seventh in scoring at 123.5 a game and its opponents have averaged 110.9, the second-softest schedule in the league. lead.headline: The Champ Benched the Win
lead.deck: Ben Football Team beat Send Nudes 143.62 to 141.10 while Baker Mayfield's 19.08 points sat on the defending champion's bench, and the race for the last playoff spots just got very crowded.

stories.headline: Six Games, One Lineup Decision That Swung the Standings
intro: Week 11 had two blowouts over 85 points, one game decided by less than a field goal, and a playoff picture that now has four teams tied at 8-3 behind Bijan Your Face. Here is how every game was won and lost, with three regular-season weeks left before the playoffs start in Week 15.

p: Ben Football Team won 143.62 to 141.10, and Send Nudes will be looking at this lineup for a while. Kirk Cousins started at quarterback and scored 8.4. Baker Mayfield scored 19.08 on the bench, and Aaron Rodgers added 15.98 there too. Start Mayfield over Cousins and Send Nudes wins by about eight.

Everything else went to plan for the champ: Jahmyr Gibbs scored 27.8, Mike Evans 22.9, Joe Burrow 19.9 and Derrick Henry 19.1. Ja'Marr Chase managed only 8.1 and Tyler Warren 3.2. Ben won with balance: Chuba Hubbard 26.0, Patrick Mahomes 24.96, Emmett Johnson 24.3 and Jared Goff 20.36. DK Metcalf's 1.2 nearly gave it back.
sections.note: Both teams are now 8-3. Jeff Longwood called this one as his Upset of the Week, with Ben as a 15-point underdog.

p: Stroke The Post scored 161.84, the most of anyone this week, and ClutchJuice scored 46.40, the least. The 115.44-point margin was the week's widest.

Stroke's damage came everywhere: CeeDee Lamb 30.2, Travis Kelce 25.4, Javonte Williams 24.1, Chris Olave 19.2 and James Cook 17.2. ClutchJuice played without Drake Maye, who is out with an ankle injury, and Anthony Richardson scored 0.2 in his place. Isaiah Davis added zero.
sections.note: Stroke has won four straight and sits at 8-3. ClutchJuice is 3-8, and every loss improves its own 2027 first.

p: brimley beat God Bless Vodka 151.58 to 135.36 for its seventh straight win. Remember when brimley was 1-2 and facing the toughest schedule in the league? It's 8-3 now.

DJ Moore led brimley with 23.1, Bucky Irving added 19.0 and Malik Nabers 18.5, and Ted Hurst III scored 22.6 on the bench without costing anything. Vodka got 22.44 from Justin Herbert, 22.22 from Cam Ward and 19.3 from Jameson Williams, but started Tyler Allgeier (2.3) while Xavier Worthy scored 11.8 on the bench. That swap alone wasn't enough to close a 16-point gap.
sections.note: Vodka has lost four straight and is 2-9.

p: Sheev won 146.66 to 126.32 for a third straight win, and the George Pickens trade paid off immediately: Pickens scored 23.8 in his first week. Brock Purdy added 22.2, Tetairoa McMillan 19.1, Breece Hall 19.0 and Parker Washington 18.3.

Very Naughty Boys had the week's biggest running back game, Jonah Coleman's 34.9, plus 22.8 from Jack Bech and 21.2 from Antonio Williams. But J.K. Dobbins started and scored zero, and rookie Fernando Mendoza scored 23.88 on the bench while J.J. McCarthy started and scored 14.22.
sections.note: Very Naughty Boys is 0-11. Sheev is 4-7, two games out of sixth with three to play.

Panic Trade Project had little to work with. Joe Milton started at quarterback and scored 6.34, Kyle Monangai 1.8, Devin Singletary 2.0 and Ja'Kobi Lane zero. Carnell Tate's 13.8 led the team.

stories.headline: Ben Is 8-3 and I Still Don't Believe It
paragraphs: Ben Football Team is 8-3. Ben Football Team's all-play record says it's a 5-6 team. That's a luck factor of +2.82, the biggest in the league by almost a full win. Ben isn't good. Ben is a guy who keeps hitting on 17 and drawing a four. Enjoy it, Ben. The house always collects.

Meanwhile the commissioner, Sheev, is 4-7 with an all-play record of nearly 7-4. That's -2.73 in luck, the worst in the league, on the fifth-most points scored. Somebody check whether the commish is getting reverse-rigged by his own league settings.
Send Nudes lost by 2.52 points with 19.08 sitting on the bench. I want that lineup framed and hung in the league office. Right next to it: Very Naughty Boys starting J.K. Dobbins for a zero.
Jeff Longwood went 6 for 6 on Sunday, including Ben as his Upset of the Week. Six for six. I've been doing this for years and I've never gone 6 for 6 on anything, including a grocery list.

brimley has won seven straight. Nobody is talking about brimley. Everybody should be talking about brimley. It's 8-3 with the fourth-best all-play mark in the league, and unlike Ben, it actually earned it.
And Very Naughty Boys is 0-11, which, honestly, is going great. It owns its own 2027 first and Sheev's. Lose out, collect two premium picks, laugh at all of us in 2028.

breakdown.headline: 3-7, Still Second in Value, and a First-Round Pick Spent on George Pickens
p: Sheev is 3-7, has won two straight, and is still second in dynasty value at 72,617, up 982 since last Sunday. It scores 145.8 a game, sixth, against the third-toughest schedule in the league, 144.0 a game. Its all-play record is 5.91 wins and its luck factor is -2.91, the worst in the league. The projected win total is 5.5.

On Wednesday Sheev bought again. It got George Pickens (4,064) and its own 2027 second (1,626) back from Panic Trade Project for Kyle Monangai (1,719), De'Zhaun Stribling (1,580, on injured reserve), Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third (1,114) and #StopAsianHate's 2028 first (2,208). That's 5,690 in and 6,621 out, a loss of 931 on paper. The rest of the roster covered it: Brock Purdy gained 706 to 6,775, Isaiah Likely 614, Luther Burden III 568 and Parker Washington 355. Tetairoa McMillan was the drop, down 529 to 3,994.

The quarterback room is still the most valuable part of the roster: Purdy, Jayden Daniels (5,997) and Lamar Jackson (5,116, on injured reserve and likely out for the regular season). Behind them are Burden (4,891), Washington (4,319) and now Pickens. Forty-four percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, and the weighted age is 25.3. One detail nobody noticed: Jalon Daniels, a Wednesday claim on the bench, is the rookie who starts for Tampa Bay if Baker Mayfield can't.

The picks thinned out. Sheev holds Ben Football Team's 2027 first (projected mid, 3,244), its own 2027 second, #StopAsianHate's 2028 second and Bijan's 2028 third: 7,271, seventh in the league. Its own 2027 first belongs to Very Naughty Boys, its 2027 third and 2028 second to Jackie aCHANe, its 2028 first to ClutchJuice and its 2028 third to brimley.
breakdown.verdict: A top-two roster on paper with a bottom-four record, and it keeps paying picks to add receivers.
breakdown.move: At 3-7 with four games left, stop spending future picks. Keep the 2027 second it just got back; Sheev's record makes it an early one.

breakdown.headline: 2-6, the Most FAAB in the League, and an Early First Someone Else Gets
p: God Bless Vodka is 2-6, scores 105.8 a game, ninth, and is 11th in dynasty value at 47,538, down 733. Its all-play record is 2.36 wins and its luck factor is -0.36, so the record is about what the scoring deserves. The projected win total is 4.0.

The diagnosis is still the draft capital. God Bless Vodka's 2027 first and second belong to Bijan, and that first projects early, worth 4,886. Its 2028 first belongs to Jackie aCHANe. What's left is its own 2027 third, its own 2028 second and third, and Jackie aCHANe's 2028 second: 4,825 in pick value, ninth in the league.

The roster lost value at the top. Jeremiyah Love (4,732), 21, is still the most valuable player on the team and is on injured reserve; he lost 676 this week. Nico Collins (3,703) lost 319 and Omarion Hampton (2,775) lost 318. The one riser was Tyler Allgeier, up 434 to 1,546, and with Love on IR and Zonovan Knight out, he's Arizona's lead back this week. Forty-two percent of the value is in players 25 or younger.

One more thing for the chart. God Bless Vodka has spent $4 of its FAAB all season, and its $96 is the most left in the league. It has used almost none of it, and Collins (17.81 projected) started the week on its bench.
breakdown.verdict: A rebuild without its own first-round pick, which means losing helps Bijan, not God Bless Vodka.
breakdown.move: Sell George Kittle and Collins to contenders for 2027 picks now, and spend the $96 on young players the wire keeps producing.

breakdown.headline: 8-2, Three of the Six Most Valuable Players, and the Oldest Roster in the League
p: Here's what I'm hearing: the champs don't care how old they are as long as they're 8-2. Send Nudes scores 176.1 a game, second in the league, its all-play record of 8.36 wins is second, and it projects for 11.5 wins. It's third in dynasty value at 69,261, down 1,012 since last Sunday.

The top is elite. Jahmyr Gibbs (10,454), Ja'Marr Chase (9,211) and Joe Burrow (7,919) are the second, fourth and sixth most valuable players in the league, and Chase gained 406 and Burrow 228 this week. The drops were everywhere else: Kyren Williams lost 719, A.J. Brown lost 500 and is on injured reserve, Tyler Warren lost 277 and Derrick Henry 237.

Forty percent of the value is in players 29 or older, the highest share in the league, and the weighted age, 28.4, is the oldest. The quarterback room is Burrow, Kirk Cousins (38.3), Baker Mayfield (31.6) and Aaron Rodgers (43.0). Send Nudes has spent $25 of FAAB all season, second-least in the league; the latest were Mike Gesicki ($8), who starts at tight end, and Jauan Jennings ($3), who replaced CJ Daniels, a $6 claim a week earlier.

The picks don't help much. Send Nudes holds its own 2027 third, Ben Football Team's 2027 third and its own 2028 first, second and third: 6,837, eighth in the league. Its 2027 first and second belong to Very Naughty Boys.
breakdown.verdict: The best roster in the league for the next six weeks, and one of the fastest-aging.
breakdown.move: Win the title now. In the offseason, sell Henry, Cousins and Mike Evans before the market does it for you.

breakdown.headline: Players Finally Worth More Than Picks, by 333, and Three 2027 Firsts Still in the Drawer
p: ClutchJuice is 3-6, scores 94.2 a game, 11th, and is ninth in dynasty value at 51,655. Here's what changed: when this desk last looked, in Week 7, its picks were worth more than its players. Not anymore. The players are worth 25,994 and the picks 25,661, a gap of 333. The picks are still the most valuable stash in the league by 3,771.

The roster is still Drake Maye (7,492), 24, and everyone else. The risers this week: Jordan Watkins gained 624, Carson Beck (taxi) gained 417 and is in line to start for Arizona with Gardner Minshew II hurt, Pat Bryant gained 258 and Caleb Douglas 229. The fallers: Kyle Pitts Sr. lost 338, Braelon Allen 279 and Mason Taylor 259. Eighty-six percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, the most in the league, and it's the only team with nothing in players 29 or older.

The pick list, straight from Sleeper. In 2027: its own first (projected early, 4,976), #StopAsianHate's (mid, 3,277) and brimley's (late, 2,535); its own, Panic Trade Project's and Jackie aCHANe's seconds; #StopAsianHate's and Very Naughty Boys' thirds. In 2028: its own first and Sheev's first, its own second, and its own and brimley's thirds.
The projected win total is 3.7. Every loss from here helps the one pick that matters most, its own 2027 first.
breakdown.verdict: Still the league's biggest pick stash, now with a roster that's caught up to it on paper. Not yet on the field.
breakdown.move: Stop waiting on Beck and Watkins to become the plan. Package the brimley first, the late one, with a second for a young receiver who's already producing, and give Maye somebody to throw to.

breakdown.headline: The Toughest Schedule in the League, Two Quarterbacks Rising, and Up to Fourth
p: brimley is 5-3, fourth in scoring at 161.2 a game, and has faced 155.9 a game, still the toughest schedule in the league. Its all-play record is 5.82 wins and its luck factor is -0.82. Dynasty value rose 1,502 to 67,518, up one spot to fourth, and the projected win total is 9.4.

Trevor Lawrence (6,045) gained 353 and Jordan Love (4,883) gained 289, and Shedeur Sanders, on the taxi squad, gained 391 to 1,137 and is expected to start for Cleveland this week. The waiver work this week was churn. It paid $5 for Jaydon Blue and cut him, picked up and released Roschon Johnson, and claimed Tyler Huntley for $1, who is out with a toe injury. It lost the Gardner Minshew II auction to #StopAsianHate, $17 to $23. It has $68 left.

Its own 2027 first belongs to ClutchJuice. Only 24% of the value is in players 25 or younger, second-lowest in the league after Stroke The Post.
breakdown.verdict: A playoff team that has played the hardest schedule in the league, with an older roster than the rank suggests.
breakdown.move: Don't sell. Use the 2028 second and some of the $68 to add a running back, because Saquon Barkley is losing snaps to Elijah Mitchell.

breakdown.headline: 4-6, Two Trades in Six Days, and the Biggest Gain in the League
p: My sources say Panic Trade Project finally decided what it is. In six days it traded Bo Nix and Emeka Egbuka to #StopAsianHate for Jalen Hurts and George Pickens, then flipped Pickens to Sheev on Wednesday. Dynasty value rose 1,899 to 58,586, the biggest gain in the league, and Panic stays seventh.

Wednesday's return: Kyle Monangai (1,719), De'Zhaun Stribling (1,580, on injured reserve), Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third (1,114) and #StopAsianHate's 2028 first (2,208), for Pickens (4,064) and Sheev's 2027 second (1,626). That's a 931 gain on paper, and Monangai starts this week in Chicago's 30.0.

The standings still say rebuild. Panic is 4-6, has lost three straight, scores 92.9 a game, 11th, and its luck factor of +1.91 is the third-best in the league. It projects for 5.0 wins. Seventy-seven percent of the value is in players 25 or younger, second only to ClutchJuice, and the weighted age, 24.2, is the youngest in the league. Too much of it is hurt: Jaxson Dart (3,915) and Hurts (3,169) are on injured reserve, and Carnell Tate (3,387) is questionable.

The pick pile is third in the league at 19,359: two 2027 firsts (its own, projected mid, and Stroke The Post's, projected late), Stroke's and Ben Football Team's 2027 seconds, Jackie aCHANe's 2027 third, two 2028 firsts (its own and #StopAsianHate's), its own and Stroke's 2028 seconds and its own and Jackie's 2028 thirds. Its own 2027 second belongs to ClutchJuice and its own 2027 third to Jackie.
breakdown.verdict: The cleanest rebuild in the league: young, cheap, and holding four first-round picks.
breakdown.move: Keep selling anything over 26 for picks. Nothing in the Philadelphia quarterback mess is worth protecting; the picks are.

Its 2027 first and third belong to ClutchJuice, its 2028 second to Sheev, and its 2028 first went to Sheev and then, on Wednesday, to Panic Trade Project.

Jonathan Taylor lost 758 to 4,320, the biggest drop on the roster, and on Thursday he ran 11 times for 21 yards. Chris Olave lost 513 and Drake London 258. Matthew Stafford (up 257) and James Cook III (up 207) were the risers.

Only 17% of the value is in players 25 or younger, the lowest share in the league, and the weighted age, 27.4, is third-oldest. Caleb Williams (7,484) and CeeDee Lamb (7,028) are the core, and Travis Kelce is 37. The only move this week was an $8 claim on Emari Demercado for Savion Williams, and Demercado started Thursday.

The pick drawer holds Stroke's own 2028 first and third, 3,223, 11th in the league and ahead of only Ben Football Team. Its 2027 first and second and its 2028 second belong to Panic Trade Project, and its 2027 third belongs to brimley.
breakdown.verdict: A contender built for this season, with no 2027 capital to rebuild with later.
breakdown.move: Ride it. Stroke's own 2027 first belongs to Panic, so losing helps nobody here. If a back is the price of a title push, Taylor's value is falling anyway.

breakdown.headline: 7-3, the Luckiest Record, Last in Value, and One Pick Left
p: Here's what I'm hearing: nobody in this league believes in Ben Football Team, and the numbers agree with them. It's 7-3 with a luck factor of +2.55, the best in the league, and an all-play record of 4.45 wins. It scores 126.3 a game, seventh, against the second-softest schedule, 123.2. It projects for 8.8 wins, and it's last in dynasty value at 40,789, up 870.

The risers were the young backs. Emmett Johnson gained 781 to 2,442 and leads Kansas City's backfield with Kenneth Walker III out. Bhayshul Tuten gained 502 to 4,036, Patrick Mahomes 386 to 5,740 and Chuba Hubbard 346. Ben's one trade since my last chart sent Ricky Pearsall and its own 2027 fifth to Jackie aCHANe for Chris Rodriguez Jr. (1,078), who's on the bench.
Thirty-one percent of the value is in players 29 or older, third-highest in the league, and the weighted age is 26.7. Both starting quarterbacks are past 31: Mahomes and Jared Goff (32.1).

The pick drawer has one thing in it: Ben's own 2028 second, 1,386, the fewest in the league. Its 2027 first belongs to Sheev, its 2027 second to Panic Trade Project, its 2027 third to Send Nudes, and its 2028 first and third to Bijan.
breakdown.verdict: A real playoff team for 2026 with nothing in the drawer for 2027.
breakdown.move: Go for it, because there's no pick to protect. Just don't sell Tuten or Emmett Johnson to do it; they're the two most valuable young players on the roster.

breakdown.headline: 5-5, Three Sales in Half an Hour, and the Biggest Drop in the League
p: Jackie aCHANe is 5-5 and has lost two straight. It lost 2,618 in dynasty value since last Sunday, the most in the league, and fell to 11th at 48,413. It scores 107.8 a game, eighth, against the softest schedule in the league, 113.1. Its all-play record is 2.91 wins, its luck factor of +2.09 is the second-best, and its lineup efficiency, 82%, is 11th. It projects for 5.9 wins.

The trades. Within half an hour on the Friday of Week 10, Jackie sent Chris Rodriguez Jr. to Ben Football Team for Ricky Pearsall and Ben's 2027 fifth, sent Pearsall to ClutchJuice for ClutchJuice's 2028 fourth, and sent Jakobi Meyers to Bijan for its own 2027 fifth. Two starters went out for two fifths and a fourth.

The rest of the chart reads like a ward. De'Von Achane (3,828), Malik Willis, Alec Pierce, Wan'Dale Robinson, Terry McLaurin and Jayden Reed all carry injured-reserve designations, and Kyler Murray and Woody Marks are out this week. Matthew Golden (5,099) is the most valuable player on the roster and is on bye. Bryce Young lost 327, Tucker Kraft 264 and Daniel Jones 226.

The picks are the healthy part: 14,919, fourth in the league. Jackie holds two 2027 firsts (its own, projected mid, and Bijan's, projected late), the 2027 thirds of Sheev, Panic Trade Project and Bijan, two 2028 firsts (its own and God Bless Vodka's) and Sheev's 2028 second. Its own 2027 second belongs to ClutchJuice, its 2027 and 2028 thirds to Panic and its 2028 second to God Bless Vodka.
breakdown.verdict: A team selling like a rebuild while sitting in a tie for sixth.
breakdown.move: Pick one. The sales say rebuild, so finish it: Young and David Montgomery aren't part of the next good Jackie team.

dynasty.method: Dynasty score = market value of every rostered player plus draft picks. Player values come from FantasyCalc's superflex, 12-team PPR dynasty market, which covers about 400 players and already prices in age; deeper depth players get a small estimate by years in the league. Pick values also come from FantasyCalc, with 2027 firsts valued early, mid or late by the original owner's current standing. Rosters and pick ownership come straight from Sleeper. Updated with each Sunday Edition. Projected wins add the current record to 4 remaining games, played at a rate that blends all-play win rate with a strength score (half points per game, half this week's lineup projection).

tradeGrades.headline: Bijan Keeps Buying, and Ben Runs Out of Picks
tradeGrades.intro: Two new trades since the last graded edition, both made Monday night after Week 11 ended, and Bijan Your Face is in both. I grade every trade three ways: value, fit and timing. Value is market price, using FantasyCalc's dynasty values for players and the same pick values as our Dynasty Rankings. Fit is whether the pieces solve a real roster problem. Timing is whether the move matches where the team actually is, not where the manager hopes it is.

trades.title: Waddle to Ben for Hockenson and a second

sides.reason: Brock Bowers is questionable with an ankle injury, and Friday's Mark Andrews pickup scored 3.4 in his first start. Hockenson is the better insurance, and Bijan Your Face got a second-round pick for making the move. It received about 3,200 in value for a 28-year-old receiver worth about 1,800.

The fit is real: Sam LaPorta made Hockenson a spare, and Ben's receivers scored 1.2 and 5.0 in Week 11. The price isn't. Ben paid its 2028 second on top of a player of equal value, and after this deal it owns no pick in the first three rounds of 2027 or 2028. An 8-3 record with the all-play mark of a 5-6 team is not the time to empty the cupboard.

trades.title: Shakir to Bijan for a third

sides.reason: Davante Adams and Michael Wilson are both in the IR slot, so receiver depth was a real need for a 10-1 team. Shakir is 26.8, not a rental, and Bijan paid a third-round pick it got from Ben in an earlier trade. Small win on value, good fit.

Shakir scored 15.3 on Sheev's bench in Week 11, so he wasn't helping. At 4-7 and two games out of sixth with three to play, turning a spare receiver into a pick is the right instinct. The return is modest, but it comes from Ben, whose roster scores like a .500 team.

trades.title: Andrews to Bijan for a fifth

sides.reason: The 9-1 team gave up its own 2027 fifth for a tight end worth 1,455 and got a sixth thrown back. FantasyCalc doesn't price either pick. By Sunday morning Brock Bowers was listed questionable with an ankle injury, so the fit is obvious. Bijan cut Darren Waller to make room. The minus is age: Andrews is 31, so this is a rental. But a team built to win in December is renting at the right time.

Selling a 31-year-old tight end at 2-8 is the right timing for a team ranked 10th in our dynasty rankings. The return is the problem: a fifth-round pick from a 9-1 team that should pick late, and Vodka sent its own sixth back. Andrews scored 16.2 on Vodka's bench in Week 10. Vodka used the open roster spot on Jayden Reed, who is on injured reserve. Right idea, thin return.

trades.title: Pickens to Sheev for a first

sides.reason: Sheev took back 5,690 in market value for 6,621, a loss of 931, and the biggest piece it paid was #StopAsianHate's 2028 first. Pickens is 25.7, so he fits a roster built around 2027, and getting its own 2027 second back is smart, because Sheev's record makes that an early second. But a 3-7 team projected for 5.5 wins shouldn't be spending a first to win now.

Panic turned a receiver it had owned for six days into a 2028 first, a 2027 third, a 24-year-old back who starts this week and a 23-year-old receiver on injured reserve. That's a 931 value win and the right direction for a 4-6 team with the youngest roster in the league. The minus: Sheev's 2027 second projects early, and FantasyCalc's generic second-round value undersells what Panic gave back.

trades.title: Meyers to Bijan for a fifth

sides.reason: A 9-1 team added a receiver worth 1,292 for a 2027 fifth-round pick that FantasyCalc doesn't even price. That is a value win and the right timing for a team that should be playing in Week 17. The minus is age: Meyers is 30, so this is a rental. I grade the trade, not the lineup, but Bijan started Meyers on Sunday, got 6.4, benched Ryan Flournoy's 19.1 and lost by 2.68.

Jackie got its own fifth-round pick back for a receiver it had in its lineup as of Thursday. It was 5-5 and tied for the last playoff spot when it made the trade. Two days later it scored 60.82, its lowest score of the season. If Jackie is rebuilding, a fifth is too little for a 1,292 asset. If it is contending, it shouldn't be selling at all.

tradeGrades.note: Andrews's value is FantasyCalc's dynasty value from our Nov. 22 data pull. The Pickens trade keeps its Nov. 19 values, and Week 10 trades keep the values and grades from the edition that graded them (Nov. 17). Trade details come straight from Sleeper's transaction records.
